ibcPage.description: How tokens flow between chains over IBC. Thicker links mean more 24-hour volume.
ibcPage.mapLabel: Map of IBC connections between chains
ibcPage.hint: Hover, focus or select a chain to highlight its connections. Drag to pan; use Ctrl or ⌘ with the scroll wheel, the + and − keys, or the buttons to zoom; press 0 to reset.

multichainPage.description: The wider Cosmos-style ecosystem at a glance — simulated figures for each connected chain.
multichainPage.registryOnly: Registered for the demo — not selectable yet
multichainPage.explainHint: Plain-language definitions of the figures on this page. All values are simulated.

explain.tvl: The value of tokens staked or held in the network's simulated economy, at simulated prices. Real "total value locked" figures use varying definitions and are not used here.
explain.height: How many blocks the chain has produced since it started. It grows by one with every block.
explain.validators: The operators that propose and sign blocks. The number is the size of the active set.
explain.apr: The estimated yearly reward for staking, as a percentage before commission. It moves with inflation and with the share of tokens that are staked.
explain.bonded: The share of the total token supply that is staked. A higher share means more of the supply is securing the chain.
explain.tx24h: Transactions included in blocks over the last 24 hours across all listed chains.

heartbeatPage.description: The pulse of {{chain}}: every block is a beat — spacing follows block time, height follows transaction count.
heartbeatPage.legend: Beat height = transactions in the block
heartbeatPage.chartLabel: Heartbeat trace: {{rate}} blocks per minute, {{seconds}} seconds between blocks
